item: Row 369: a restore's staging check reads only regular files, never past the size the manifest lists
summary: _finalize_staged (the check every upload and volume-set restore passes) hashed each staged member with a plain open read to its end after an exists() check that follows links, and read the staged manifest.json with read_text, so a member that was a link (to /dev/zero or any file), a pipe or a device was read whole and a pipe at the manifest's name blocked the restore for ever; members now read through the backup checks' reader (open_regular + bounded_hash.sha256_read): a link, a pipe or a device is named unreadable without a read, a member is read at most one byte past the size its entry lists (larger is a mismatch), a dangling link is not 'missing', and the manifest is read through read_manifest_json at most STAGED_MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES (256 MiB, the volume manifest's ceiling), anything else refused as unreadable; an entry with no whole-number size is still hashed, regular files only; a whole staging verifies as before.
